newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - McDonald's EPS view cut.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Peter Oakes said Wednesday he trimmed his earnings estimates for McDonald's Corp for 1997 to $2.48 a share from $2.50, and for 1998 to $2.82 from $2.85.
-- he said he reduced estimates after the fast-food chain reported disappointing U.S. sales in May.
-- McDonald's franchisee sources have said that May U.S. same-stores sales were down about five percent.
-- Oakes added that, based on preliminary figures, he estimated McDonald's international same-store sales in May were up about one to two percent, which was stronger than had been projected.
-- said he expects continued progress in McDonald's international operations, which accounted for about 60 percent of its operating profit, as the year progresses.
